title: Long-Term Safety Planning
learning_goal: Develop a long-term safety plan that supports stability after DFV.

content.micro_lesson: Long-term safety includes stable housing, financial planning, safe communication, ongoing risk monitoring, and maintaining support networks. Safety evolves over time and requires regular review.
content.activity: Complete the long-term safety plan template.
content.caseworker_flags: Learner reports unstable housing or ongoing contact with perpetrator.
content.escalation_trigger: Any new high-risk disclosure triggers immediate triage.

title: Rebuilding Identity
learning_goal: Explore personal identity beyond the DFV experience.

content.micro_lesson: DFV often erodes identity through control, criticism, and isolation. Rebuilding involves reconnecting with values, interests, strengths, and personal goals.
content.activity: Complete a values and identity worksheet.
content.caseworker_flags: Expressions of extreme self-blame or loss of identity.
content.escalation_trigger: Statements indicating inability to function or care for children trigger support referral.

title: Financial Independence
learning_goal: Learn strategies for financial stability and independence after DFV.

content.micro_lesson: Financial abuse can create long-term barriers. Recovery includes budgeting, rebuilding credit, accessing financial support services, and planning for future independence.
content.activity: Create a basic financial plan using the provided template.
content.caseworker_flags: Learner reports no access to income or financial control by perpetrator.
content.escalation_trigger: Active financial control or sabotage triggers urgent safety review.

title: Healthy Relationships
learning_goal: Understand the characteristics of healthy, respectful relationships.

content.micro_lesson: Healthy relationships include respect, trust, communication, boundaries, equality, and emotional safety. Recognising red flags helps prevent future harm.
content.activity: Compare past relationship patterns with healthy relationship principles.
content.caseworker_flags: Learner expresses fear of future relationships or repeats harmful patterns.
content.escalation_trigger: Any indication of returning to a dangerous relationship triggers safety intervention.

title: Emotional Healing
learning_goal: Learn emotional healing strategies for recovery after DFV.

content.micro_lesson: Healing involves processing trauma, rebuilding self-worth, reconnecting socially, and developing coping strategies. Support may include counselling, peer groups, or cultural healing practices.
content.caseworker_flags: Signs of severe emotional distress or trauma symptoms.
content.escalation_trigger: Expressions of hopelessness or inability to cope trigger clinical referral.

title: Future Planning
learning_goal: Create a future plan that supports safety, wellbeing, and personal goals.

content.micro_lesson: Future planning includes education, employment, housing, parenting goals, and ongoing support. Setting achievable steps builds confidence and stability.
content.caseworker_flags: Unrealistic goals or lack of support systems.
content.escalation_trigger: Any barrier that threatens safety or stability triggers caseworker review.

title: Program Reflection & Next Steps
learning_goal: Reflect on the 6‑week program and identify ongoing support needs.

content.micro_lesson: This final lesson reviews key learnings across all weeks: understanding DFV, child impact, safety planning, support networks, accountability, and long-term recovery.
content.activity: Write a 250‑word reflection summarising progress and next steps.
content.caseworker_flags: Any new disclosures of risk or instability.
content.escalation_trigger: Any high-risk content in final reflection triggers immediate triage.
